prompts.prompt: In TimescaleDB 2.25, the new ColumnarIndexScan fast path can make MIN and MAX queries how many times faster than before. Answer with the exact multiplier.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/timescaledb/references/versions/2.x.md - TimescaleDB 2.25 section: MIN/MAX fast paths are up to 289x faster by reading only _ts_meta_min/max metadata.

prompts.prompt: Starting with which TimescaleDB version did newly created continuous aggregates default to having real-time aggregation turned off. Answer with the exact version number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/timescaledb/SKILL.md - Continuous Aggregates section: the default changed in TimescaleDB 2.13, where real-time aggregates became disabled by default for new continuous aggregates.

prompts.prompt: When you create a TimescaleDB hypertable without specifying a chunk time interval, what is the default chunk interval. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/timescaledb/SKILL.md - Hypertable Architecture section: create_hypertable code comment states the default chunk_time_interval is 7 days; the chunk interval sizing table also lists 1-week chunks as the default for low ingest.
